Pri: Dropping proposed rollout checklist for calibration cohorts + latency-aware quant selection. Short version here.
Omar: Nice. What's new vs previous playbooks?
Pri: New pieces: define per-tenant "calibration buckets" (token mix, latency sensitivity, quality budget). Use a hybrid canary: synthetic playback per-bucket + live shadowing. Canary sample = 0.3% per-bucket, global shadow = 2%.
Leah: How do you define a "quality budget"?
Pri: Quality budget = allowable deg_score delta (default 1.2% abs) and latency headroom (p95 delta <= +120ms). Buckets marked "tight-latency" require manual gating for expansion beyond canary.
Omar: Synthetic prompt suite—details?
Pri: Playback harness runs ~5k canonical prompts per bucket (mix of short/long, system prompts, edge cases). Collect deg_score, token_coherence, embedding_drift. Block rollout if deg_score > 1.0% OR embedding_drift > 2.5% on playback.
Leah: Runtime routing behavior?
Pri: Routing order at request time: 1) tenant_override (if provided) 2) bucket-compatible profile 3) cost-preferred profile that satisfies SLO checks (latency/quality). If live p95 rises beyond bucket headroom for 3 consecutive windows -> auto-switch to next-safe profile.
Omar: What headers/traces do we need?
Pri: Require headers: X-Quant-Bucket, X-Quant-Profile, X-Quant-Flags. Traces include trace.quant.bucket and trace.quant.profile. Example log line: {"ts":"...","req":"r9","bucket":"chat-lowlat","quant_profile":"fp8-lite","deg_score":0.014,"p95_ms":120}
Leah: Fallback sequence?
Pri: Fallback order = tenant_override -> INT8-compatible profile -> same-precision with quant optimizations disabled -> float32 baseline. Always log fallback decision and cost delta.
EvalBot: offline-playback:bucket=chat-lowlat status=passed deg=0.008 embed_drift=1.4
devops-bot: canary started: model=redwood-mosaic-priority-fp8 sample=0.3% shadow=2%
Omar: CI gating? PRs that add/modify quant profiles must include: YAML canary block in model manifest, synthetic-playback report, and per-bucket budget declaration. Add lint rule to fail CI if missing.
Pri: Also proposing "early-stop" criteria: if synthetic suite OR live shadow shows regression with bootstrap p-value < 0.01, halt expansion immediately and notify SRE + model owner.
Leah: Per-request vs per-token mixed precision?
Pri: Keep per-request for initial rollouts. Per-token mixing allowed only under experimental flag and requires separate canary + offline eval.
Omar: Good. Can we add a lightweight dashboard slice keyed by bucket so product owners can see cohort impact?
Pri: Yes, will add dashboard filters: quant_profile, bucket, tenant.
Leah: OK thanks. Please open PRs for: manifest-lint, route headers spec, synthetic-suite CI, and runbook.
Pri: Will do and ping SRE. Thanks everyone.
